scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests unit server worker scripts *.js *.json wrangler.jsonc index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests unit server worker scripts *.js *.json wrangler.jsonc index.html
scripts.test:browser:production: VITE_ACCOUNT_MODE=guest npm run build && playwright test --config=playwright.production.config.js
scripts.test:operations: python3 -m unittest ops/test_operations.py && node --test ops/edge-monitor.test.mjs ops/dashboard.test.mjs
scripts.worker:deploy:staging: VITE_ACCOUNT_MODE=account npm run build && NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/deploy-public.mjs --staging
scripts.worker:deploy:production: VITE_ACCOUNT_MODE=account npm run build && NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/deploy-public.mjs
scripts.build:server: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p build/server/migrations && cp server/migrations/*.sql build/server/migrations/
